reason: Provides final package quality and safety checklist.
Check exact safe/conditional commands and truthful operational reporting.
Check every provider/deployment/configuration action had exact authorization and rollback.
Check targets, additive migrations, data preservation, cleanup recovery, and forbidden operations.
Check preview zero-write, write authorization, userscript, audit/provenance, and off rollback.
Ensure historical per-user-key evidence is retained but never reused as new-model acceptance or authorization.
Check all parent decisions and final acceptance gates are satisfied.
Check complete phase ordering, parity, and rollback boundaries.
